seed.cause: RetireDemoCatalogSeeder classified every SKU absent from dongcheng_catalog.json as demo, removed images/profiles and deleted or deactivated SKUs without provenance.
seed.fix: Remove retirement from DatabaseSeeder and retain a non-mutating compatibility entrypoint, including explicit direct invocation. No environment flag enables this destructive cleanup.
seed.regression: Two non-catalog SKUs, two image rows, image file checksums, profiles and masters must remain identical across two retirement invocations. This is not certification of the entire seed chain.
seed.deployment_policy: Do not run db:seed, migrate:fresh, truncate, cleanup or data restoration on an existing environment as part of this fix. Full approved seed-command dry run and before/after reconciliation on an isolated copy are still required before separately authorized seeding.

p08.cause: DOCUMENT required stock_documents.warehouse_id, absent from the canonical schema.
p08.fix: Filter receipt by persisted dst_warehouse_id plus inbound.view; issue by persisted src_warehouse_id plus outbound.view, before union/count/pagination. Do not OR both directions indiscriminately.
p08.unchanged: Existing GET history records/summary/detail, request identity, cursor isolation, source permissions and tenant guards. Schema truly absent remains 503; authorized empty source remains empty, never synthesized evidence. History is not a mutation receipt.

p10.fix: Exact /api/v1/auth/me FastCGI location disables gzip on default and perf templates while preserving request method, URI, query, If-Match, forwarding and error policies; Laravel profile responses add private, no-store, no-transform.
p10.unchanged: Use the actual strong response ETag for If-Match. Weak ETags remain rejected; no prefix stripping, numeric fallback or automatic PATCH replay.
p10.edge_dependency: Any external proxy/CDN outside this repository must also preserve the profile response validator; verify actual browser/native response with Accept-Encoding:gzip and identity after release. Do not disable compression globally.
p10.transport_test: scripts/test-p10-nginx-etag.py uses checked-in nginx templates and synthetic local FastCGI, not a live account or authenticated end-to-end environment.

evidence.candidate_scope: PostgreSQL reproduced deletion and DOCUMENT 503, then passed 38 tests/513 assertions; nginx transport passed 12 cases. Candidate success is not a release claim.
evidence.final_sha_tests: The source-only workflow checks out the triggering SHA and must pass both database jobs and transport checks without editing code or writing git refs.
